joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: native in every arm; original completion boundary retained
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: All original STORE/LOAD prepare, submission, completion and release paths unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; every request completes1024 output tokens ignoring EOS.
fixed.B_LOAD_ORDER: native, no LOAD ordering adapter installed
fixed.admission: Original native priorities and waiting order retained. Candidate may break immediately before the selected original waiting allocation, then at most once more on its next native turn if the recorded LOADs lack scheduler ACK. Other native heads pass through unchanged; no request move, pop or skip.
fixed.B_GC_OBSERVATION: identical passive callbacks in all four cells
fixed.recovery_fit_or_repeat: No fit_once, repeat or retry-defer policy remains installed during service; true native baseline. The yield policy may reuse pinned qualification/compiler helpers without installing their service policy.
fixed.observations: Identical compact output capture, native completion/order/allocation/source observers, passive GC callbacks and recovery-start-yield-ack evidence in both arms.
fixed.B_RECOVERY_START_YIELD_ACK: native/yield_ack according to fixed ABBA; sole policy variable

selection: Initial opportunity qualification is exactly the frozen r01 yield_once policy. Select one original waiting-allocation opportunity with recorded pending LOAD beneficiaries and a zero-external recovery target; after the first break retain only that decision until scheduler ACK or the fixed entry bound. No new initial selector or threshold.
scope: Exploratory response to r01 returning to native before its recorded LOAD scheduler ACK. Test whether the bounded action can cross ACK and improve complete requests. Historical r01 raws are diagnostic evidence, not performance controls. If useful, a fixed-two-round rule with the same structure is the necessary next simple comparator.

intervention.native: Original waiting allocation/retry behavior with the same qualification and action observations; no policy break.
intervention.yield_ack: Keep the r01 initial selection and first break. Until all recorded LOADs receive scheduler ACK, allow at most one further break for the same target at its own native waiting head; pass through other native heads. Total breaks <=2. Entry step >= decision step +2 unconditionally returns to native. No wall-clock gate, new timeout, queue mutation, in-flight cancellation or transfer ownership change.

primary_readout: Verify unchanged initial opportunity qualification, actual first/second breaks, pass-through of other native heads, scheduler ACK and release/entry limit with request/task joins. Report all-request TTFT, completion, maximum generation gap, output throughput and fixed joint SLO including failures/timeouts/unfinished. Preserve copy/output work, cumulative recovery unions, common GC, post-observation materialization and phase times. Crossing ACK or reducing local wait alone does not establish request benefit.
stop_rule: Planned native/yield_ack/yield_ack/native. If first yield_ack action_count==0 or executed_breaks==0, stop before both reverse cells with explicit STOP_NO_ACTION, retain all collected raws and release the group lock. Missing action evidence aborts explicitly. Otherwise finish one fixed ABBA. No automatic repeat, threshold tuning or parameter sweep; different-run events are not matched-state controls.

resource_checks.disk_check_scope: Session/cache filesystem once after acquiring whole-group lock, before first warmup; no per-cell threshold. Source/model unchanged.
resource_checks.disk_basis: Completed r01 group raw581313352B + cache325036151B + archive40806407B =947155910B (<1GB). A2.5GiB=2684354560B prelaunch floor leaves1737198650B (~1.74GB) beyond that measured footprint. Model is cached and offline; no additional download. This is an executor disk floor, not GPU/HostKV budget.

storage_note: This session and independent empty caches use /tmp; retained model/source paths are unchanged. Require2.5GiB once after acquiring the whole-group lock and before warmup, with the original receipt and abort paths. No per-cell floor, model download or cleanup by this adapter.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap is a common diagnostic, not a storage intervention in this group; callback intervals do not prove pure CPU pause cost or recovery-policy causation.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Reuse the retained original runtime/package and model cache. This local plan preparation performs no deployment, model initialization or GPU run.
deployment.comparison_scope: All four cells, including both native controls, rerun on this GPU under one whole-group lock. Historical other-host raws are not performance controls. Early-stop retains all collected cells.

source_basis: Thin pinned adapters over frozen r01 start-yield runners. Reuse native source_handoff, fixed termination, compact output capture/passive GC and the exact whole-group lock/3GiB prelaunch/no-action-stop controller. Only new policy module, actual ACK variant namespace and child entrypoint change. Frozen r01 scripts/plan remain unchanged. An additional pinned space adapter changes only the resource-parent MINIMUM_FREE_BYTES to2.5GiB and updates its matching error text; lock identity, strict empty-GPU check and scientific behavior remain unchanged.

bounds.release_signal: all recorded LOAD task IDs have scheduler ACK; host poll or device completion alone is not scheduler ACK

correctness_check.reported_by_policy_author: CPU PASS; unchanged initial selector, action_count0/1, requested/executed breaks0..2, unconditional native release at entry step >= initial+2; no GPU or remote execution

host_binding.source_and_cache_paths: Existing B source tree and HF paths retained.
host_binding.unchanged: ACK policy/source pins; fixed GPU KV and Host KV16GiB; input/arrival/termination; common observations; whole-group flock and strict empty-GPU check; once-prelaunch space check (floor in resource_checks); no-action stop.
host_binding.prelaunch_requirement: Unchanged empty-GPU boundary must pass. Reported0MiB with100%utilization is not empty and is never ignored.

resource_retry_origin.reason: After acquiring the common lock, the group-prelaunch free-space check failed before any model/GPU cell. Parent reports PID exited and lock released. This is a resource failure, not a policy result.
resource_retry_origin.scope: New session with fresh native/yield_ack/yield_ack/native controls on the same current GPU. Only the conservative group disk floor changes; all scientific settings and host binding remain unchanged. No prior-host or zero-cell run serves as a performance control.
